description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink project and generates a search form for requirement specifications within the test management system. It initializes various components, fetches configuration and project data, and renders a Smarty template for the form.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: A generic PHP empty class used to create objects dynamically.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine class used for rendering templates in the system.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: A class managing test project data, providing methods like getOptionReqSpec and constants like GET_NOT_EMPTY_REQSPEC.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes arguments for the page based on session variables, returning an object with test project ID and name.
